name: Current Opportunity
query:
SELECT
  `tabOpportunity`.customer_name as "Customer Name::200",
  `tabOpportunity`.opportunity_name as "Opportunity Name::200",
  `tabOpportunity`.converted_by as "Onwership::200",
  `tabOpportunity`.sales_stage as "Sales Stage::200",
  `tabOpportunity`.status as "Status::200",
  `tabOpportunity`.expected_closing as "Expected Closing Date:Date:200"
FROM
  `tabOpportunity`
WHERE
  `tabOpportunity`.status = 'Open'
